description: A check of about 8 to 10 minutes for finance staff, taken before the awareness episodes (pair AB). Ten messages from the payments inbox of Brightwell Foods, a fictional company. The result is kept so the matching after-check (awareness_post_finance_ab) can show how the two compare. Organiser note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
